where_it_appears: Board agendas, capital improvement plans, bond prospectuses, airport newsroom
why_it_matters: A funded terminal program pulls in passenger systems, baggage, network and security scope on a known schedule
false_positive_warning: A 'master plan vision' with no funding line is not a project - check initiative_status

where_it_appears: Airport newsroom, Airport Improvement Magazine, Passenger Terminal Today
why_it_matters: Renovations replace in-terminal systems at their end of life - a natural displacement window
false_positive_warning: Airline-funded work on its own leased gates is usually out of scope

where_it_appears: Tender portals, board capital votes, trade press
why_it_matters: BHS replacement is a large, long, systems-heavy purchase with a named incumbent to displace
false_positive_warning: Routine conveyor maintenance contracts read like modernization in tender titles

where_it_appears: Airport newsroom, ACI conference agendas, national border-agency announcements
why_it_matters: Biometric rollouts are politically visible, funded, and always involve integration partners
false_positive_warning: A single-lane pilot is not a program; check estimated_timing and status

where_it_appears: Airport newsroom, regulatory notices, TSA/EASA directives, trade press
why_it_matters: The clearest trigger for security spend, and it creates urgency the buyer did not choose
false_positive_warning: Sector-wide advisories name many airports without any of them having a live project

where_it_appears: The portal named in procurement_system; TED for EU; KONEPS for KR; CompraNet for MX
why_it_matters: A live solicitation with a due date is the most actionable signal on the table
false_positive_warning: Re-issued or amended notices duplicate; dedupe on reference number

where_it_appears: Airport newsroom, LinkedIn, trade press appointment notices
why_it_matters: A new technology leader re-opens settled vendor decisions, usually inside their first 6 months
false_positive_warning: Interim and acting titles often revert; confirm the title is permanent

why_it_matters: Operations leaders own the systems that run the airfield and the terminal day
false_positive_warning: Reorganizations rename roles without changing the decision maker

why_it_matters: Procurement leaders set the vendor master agreements everything else has to fit through
false_positive_warning: Title inflation is common in public agencies; check reporting line

signal: Open roles in cyber / infrastructure / passenger systems
where_it_appears: Airport careers site, LinkedIn Jobs, Clay Open Jobs enrichment
why_it_matters: Hiring for a capability is the earliest public evidence of a program being stood up
false_positive_warning: Public agencies repost stale requisitions for months - check first-posted date

why_it_matters: Very specific roles map to very specific programs already underway
false_positive_warning: Contractor and staffing-agency posts misattribute to the airport

where_it_appears: Airport newsroom, route-development press, Aviation Week
why_it_matters: Sustained route growth precedes capacity investment, but it is a slow leading indicator
false_positive_warning: Seasonal and charter route announcements inflate the count

signal: Passenger volume record or capacity constraint
why_it_matters: Hitting a capacity ceiling is what converts a master plan into a funded program
false_positive_warning: Recovery-to-2019 comparisons read as growth when they are catch-up

where_it_appears: Sustainability report, ACI sustainability programs, newsroom
why_it_matters: Fuel and energy programs carry their own systems, metering and reporting scope
false_positive_warning: Net-zero pledges with a 2050 date are not procurement events

where_it_appears: Regulatory filings, investor releases, Clay funding/investor data
why_it_matters: New owners reset capital plans and vendor relationships, often within a year
false_positive_warning: Minority stake trades usually change nothing operationally

where_it_appears: CAA (UK), ANAC (BR), Aerocivil (CO), national aviation regulators
why_it_matters: For regulated airports the settlement IS the capex budget - it sets what can be bought and when
false_positive_warning: Consultation documents are proposals, not settlements

where_it_appears: ACI, AAAE, ACI EUROPE conference agendas
why_it_matters: Reveals who owns a program and the internal name they use for it - excellent for personalization
false_positive_warning: Panel moderators are not necessarily program owners
